title: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy organizes Plantation Drive under “Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam” Initiative
body_text:
The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) organised a plantation drive at Atal Akshay Urja Bhawan, New Delhi, under the “Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam” initiative, as part of its efforts to promote a clean and green workplace and encourage environmental sustainability.
The plantation drive was led by the Shri Santosh Kumar Sarangi, Secretary, Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, who planted a tree on the premises of the Ministry. Senior officials of the Ministry also participated in the drive and planted trees.
The Secretary encouraged officers and staff to actively participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing green cover and promoting sustainable practices. Officers and staff participated in the drive and reaffirmed their commitment to maintaining a clean and green workplace.
The plantation drive under “Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam” reflects the Ministry’s continued commitment to sustainability and contributes to the Government’s broader vision of promoting a greener and more sustainable future.
On #SwachhataHiSeva , MNRE reaffirmed its commitment to a cleaner and more sustainable environment through a cleanliness drive.
